form_title: Application for Grant of Licence to Manufacture for Sale or for Distribution of Class C or Class D Medical Device

slots.title: Covering Letter
slots.statutory_rule: Rule 20(1)

guidance.what_it_is: Formal statutory application letter addressed to the Central Licensing Authority (DCGI).
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Formally requests grant of Class C or Class D medical device manufacturing licence.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 20(1)
guidance.who_issues: Authorized Signatory / Managing Director of domestic manufacturing firm
mandatory_inclusions: Applied device commercial names and generic descriptions
Assigned risk classification (Class C or Class D)
Physical address of domestic manufacturing facility
BharatKosh statutory fee payment reference
critical_pitfalls: Applying for Class A or Class B devices under Form MD-7 (jurisdiction of State Licensing Authority).
Missing authorized signatory corporate stamp.

slots.title: Application (Form MD-7 Execution)
slots.statutory_rule: Rule 20(1), Form MD-7

guidance.what_it_is: Statutory application pro-forma Form MD-7 for licence to manufacture Class C or Class D medical devices.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Legal basis for grant of commercial manufacturing licence in Form MD-9.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 20(1), Form MD-7
mandatory_inclusions: Name and corporate address of applicant firm
Physical manufacturing and testing premises address
Names, chemical compositions, and intended use of applied devices
Technical staff appointment references
critical_pitfalls: Product description discrepancies between Form MD-7 and Device Master File.

slots.title: Fee Challan
slots.statutory_rule: Rule 20(1) & Second Schedule

guidance.what_it_is: Treasury payment receipt generated from BharatKosh portal (Non-Tax Receipt Portal).
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Mandatory statutory fee deposit for manufacturing site inspection and product evaluation.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Second Schedule, Rule 20(1)
mandatory_inclusions: BharatKosh Transaction Reference ID
Head of Account 0210 - Medical and Public Health
CDSCO Drawing and Disbursing Officer (DDO) code
Calculated fee covering site licence and distinct device models
critical_pitfalls: Paying under incorrect DDO or State Licensing Authority head.

slots.title: Constitution Details of the Firm
slots.statutory_rule: Rule 20(1)

guidance.what_it_is: Constitutional legal documents defining corporate ownership, shareholding, and authorized signatories.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Validates that the manufacturing entity is legally incorporated under Indian corporate law.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 20(1)
guidance.who_issues: Ministry of Corporate Affairs (ROC) / Registrar of Firms
mandatory_inclusions: Certificate of Incorporation (CIN / LLPIN)
Memorandum & Articles of Association (MoA & AoA) / Partnership Deed
Current List of Directors with DIN numbers
Board Resolution empowering designated signing officer
critical_pitfalls: Discrepancies in corporate registered address or unauthorized signatory resolution.

slots.title: Premises / Site Ownership Deed or Tenancy Agreement
slots.statutory_rule: Rule 20(1)

guidance.what_it_is: Registered title deed, land allotment letter, or registered lease/tenancy agreement of manufacturing premises.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Proves undisputed legal possession of the physical plant where manufacturing will take place.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Rule 20(1)
guidance.who_issues: Sub-Registrar of Assurances / Industrial Development Corporation (SIDC/GIDC/MIDC)
guidance.validity_period: Active lease tenure (minimum remaining validity covering licence evaluation)
mandatory_inclusions: Physical plot number, industrial estate, and geographic boundaries
Registered lease agreement with clear industrial manufacturing permitted use
Municipal / Pollution Control Board consent to establish (CTE)
critical_pitfalls: Unregistered lease deed or residential/commercial non-industrial zoning.

slots.title: DMF Part 20: Batch Release Certificates (3 Consecutive Batches)
slots.statutory_rule: Fourth Schedule Part III (Appendix II, Clause 20)

guidance.what_it_is: Finished device release testing Certificates of Analysis (CoAs) from 3 consecutive commercial production lots.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Statutory technical file requirement demonstrating design safety, manufacturing reproducibility, and clinical benefit.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Fourth Schedule Part III (Appendix II)
mandatory_inclusions: Raw quantitative test curves and acceptance criteria
Authorizing signatures of qualified technical personnel
Traceability to statutory device trade names
critical_pitfalls: Summaries without underlying test laboratory reports.
Testing performed on non-production-standard prototypes.

slots.title: Any Other Additional Documents (including Test Licence MD-13 / MD-27 permissions)
slots.statutory_rule: MDR 2017 General

guidance.what_it_is: Supplementary attachments, Form MD-13 test licence records, or Form MD-27 permissions.
guidance.why_it_is_needed: Accommodates ancillary documents or specific clarifications requested by CDSCO evaluators.
guidance.official_citation: MDR 2017 Discretionary
mandatory_inclusions: Explanatory memorandum specifying purpose of attached documents
critical_pitfalls: Attaching unreferenced, redundant files.
